normalize_coordinates: normalize pixel coordinates to normalized [-1,1] space given image dimensions
unnormalize_coordinates: unnormalize coordinates from [-1,1] space back to pixel coordinates given image dimensions
bilinear_interpolation: sample values from an image tensor at normalized coordinates using bilinear interpolation
sample_coords: sample coordinates and depth values from a depth tensor using uniform or scale weighting
to_normalized_covariance: transform a covariance matrix from pixel space to normalized [-1,1] coordinate space
